items.label: Notes before purchasing
items.value: 4G not 5G phone. Unlocked for GSM carriers like T-mobile, but not MVNO by t- mobile like Metro and Mint. Not for AT&T, Cricket, Verizon, Sprint, Tracfone, Straight Talk, Spectrum, Simple, Boost, U.S.Cellular, Assurance Wireless. No any cards, not for e-SIM

items.label: Notes after purchase
items.value: Stay away from the high temperature. Don't use it while it's charging. Stop using when it gets warm. Before turning on the phone, you need to open the back cover as the picture ① in the description. After successfully turning on the phone, please let it sit for 30 minutes to charge. Then connect to WiFi and try it out. If you are still satisfied so far, open the back cover again and insert your SIM cards to use as picture ②

9 Full-view Screen Android Phone Weight Only 193g: The aspect ratio of the cheap android phone is 18:9. The smartphone unlocked is about 0.35 inches thick and weighs only 193g, providing you with a good grip feel

items.label: RAM 2GB + ROM 16GB / 256GB TF Card Expansion
items.value: RAM 2GB of running memory helps you switch between daily apps. With 16GB of built-in storage, it is enough to store daily photos. Note; the system will occupy some storage space, so your unlocked cell phone will be less than 16GB. According to personal needs, you can add an external TF card up to 256GB for expansion. Not including TF cards

items.label: 8MP Main Smart Phone Camera
items.value: This cheap unlocked smartphone is equipped with a rear 8MP main camera and a 5MP front camera, making it a great assistant at recording beautiful moments in life.
